Cranfield University GREAT India Scholarships 2022 is a combined initiative by Cranfield University and the British Council for full-time master's students. This scholarship will provide financial assistance to students in India applying for postgraduate courses in forensics, energy, agri-food, environment, water, design, manufacturing, aerospace or transport systems. The selected scholars will receive £10,000 for tuition fees.

This scholarship scheme is part of the GREAT Scholarships 2022 campaign, which has been launched by the British Council, together with 36 UK universities, to support a number of countries in accessing excellent UK higher education opportunities.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be eligible for a full-time master's course covering forensics, environmental technology, agrifood, water, energy and power, manufacturing, transport systems or aerospace
The selected scholars will receive £10,000 for tuition fees.
A personal statement addressing the Justification for Support criteria
